newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:
Spokeswoman Sophie Petzell briefed on the informal Justice and Home Affairs Council that took place in Noordwijk, Netherlands on Wednesday and Thursday.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/98: Commissioner Martin Bangemann meets heads of European standardization organisations.
- IP/97/99: Ski instructors: the Commission continues efforts to ensure recognition of qualifications in France.
- IP/97/100: The Commission approves joint venture in the construction industry.
- IP/97/101: The Commission clears the acquisition of Meerspierson by Fortis.
- Memo/97/14: the Commission's agenda for the week of February 10-14, 1997.
